verdict.rationale: gstack is a pack of agent skills invoked through coding-agent hosts, plus a compiled browser CLI ($B). Programmatic access is a fair question for this kind of developer tool, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no API, and no claim that an API surface matches what a UI or interactive flow can do. The browser CLI and host configs are separate features, not an API-parity capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
